nodes.label: flamechart.py Performance Visualization
nodes.rationale: Draws before/after flame chart PNG from Perfetto traces with one lane per thread on a shared time scale, highlighting targeted work in magenta with its total.

nodes.label: Two-Chart Pattern for Home Changes
nodes.rationale: A Home change usually needs two charts: the start (defaults with highlight set to removed slices) and frames after it (window start:1500, RenderThread, highlight DrawFrame).

nodes.label: relay.py ADB Port Relay
nodes.rationale: Forwards local port on 127.0.0.1 to the TV ADB port (default 5555) to allow sandboxed coding assistants to connect when local network privacy restricts direct access.

nodes.label: adb-shell Library (adb-shell==0.4.4)
nodes.rationale: Core library for communicating with Android TV devices over ADB without requiring host adb binary.

nodes.label: Cryptography Library (cryptography>=46.0.7)
nodes.rationale: Underlying cryptographic primitives supporting secure ADB authentication handshakes.

nodes.label: Perfetto Python Library (perfetto==0.58.2)
nodes.rationale: Required for trace analysis and query engine integration in performance reporting tools.

nodes.label: Pillow Python Imaging Library (pillow==11.3.0)
nodes.rationale: Required for image processing in screendiff, flamechart visualization, and README card generation.

nodes.label: RSA Cryptography Library (rsa==4.9.1)
nodes.rationale: Provides ADB key signing and authentication handling for TV debugging.

nodes.label: Screenshot Privacy Blurring Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Blurs sensitive regions such as Wi-Fi network names and account avatars in both comparison images without altering comparison results.

nodes.label: screendiff.py Visual Invariance Verifier
nodes.rationale: Verifies before and after screenshots are identical outside masked regions, rendering labelled side-by-side PNGs with private details blurred.

nodes.label: Android 12+ FrameTimeline Prerequisite
nodes.rationale: Frame times and missed deadlines require Perfetto FrameTimeline, available only on Android 12 and later.

nodes.label: Launcher Trace Scenarios
nodes.rationale: Standardized scenarios: home (warm launcher resume), cold (am start -W after force-stop), coldsys (restart after memory pressure kill), nav (24 D-pad moves), and custom steps.

nodes.label: Android 9/10 Tracing Service Setup (persist.traced.enable)
nodes.rationale: On Android 9 and 10, TV tracing services must be enabled via persist.traced.enable; Android 11+ enables them by default.

nodes.label: trace_report.py Latency Reporter
nodes.rationale: Analyzes pftrace files using trace_processor_shell to report time to first frame, lifecycle slice breakdowns, frame rates, and missed deadlines.

nodes.label: trace.py Perfetto Trace Recorder
nodes.rationale: Records binary Perfetto traces over ADB for predefined launcher scenarios (home, cold, coldsys, nav, custom).

nodes.label: Choose Highlight Regex Before Looking
nodes.rationale: Choose --highlight before you look. Name the slices your change should remove, then draw. A regex fitted to whatever shrank proves nothing.

nodes.label: Pass Folders to Draw Median Run
nodes.norm_label: pass folders to draw median run
nodes.rationale: Pass folders, not single runs. The tool picks the median run by time to first frame, median frame time, and median RenderThread draw.

nodes.label: Main and Render Thread Accounting Limit
nodes.norm_label: main and render thread accounting limit
nodes.rationale: Magenta is main and render thread time only. Work moved to another thread or to the GPU is not gone: add that thread as a lane, or use the nav GPU numbers.

nodes.label: Localhost-Only Safety Rule
nodes.rationale: It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, never on your network, and has no option to change that. Other devices cannot use it to reach your TV.

nodes.label: Stop Relay After Session Cleanup Rule
nodes.norm_label: stop relay after session cleanup rule
nodes.rationale: Programs on this computer can reach the TV ADB port while it runs; stop the relay when done, as you would close network ADB itself.

nodes.label: Compare Home Only Scope Rule
nodes.rationale: Compare Home, not Live TV, HDMI or Netflix. Those capture as empty on most TVs.

nodes.label: Identical Screenshot Capture Conditions
nodes.rationale: Take both screenshots the same way: same key presses, same wait, same theme and wallpaper.

nodes.label: Never Mask Touched Regions Rule
nodes.rationale: Never mask a region your change touches. Masking is only for what changes by itself like clock, greeting, stats line, and wallpaper caption.

nodes.label: Do Not Artificially Raise Threshold Rule
nodes.norm_label: do not artificially raise threshold rule
nodes.rationale: Do not raise --threshold to make a difference go away. If something did change, say what in the PR.

nodes.label: Cold Starts Must Use HOME Intent Rule
nodes.norm_label: cold starts must use home intent rule
nodes.rationale: bench.py and cold trace send MAIN with HOME category. Starting only the component creates a regular task beside Home causing duplicate instances.

nodes.label: Keep Starred Outlier Runs Rule
nodes.rationale: A run over twice the median is starred; keep and report them rather than dropping them, as they usually reflect genuine memory pressure on 1 GB TVs.

nodes.label: No Latency Gain from Off-Thread Work Rationale
nodes.norm_label: no latency gain from off-thread work rationale
nodes.rationale: Expect no latency gain from off-main-thread work: it removes work from the main thread, but does not shorten the elapsed time to the first frame.

nodes.label: Never Commit pftrace Files Rule
nodes.rationale: Never commit .pftrace files because they contain the TV process list.

nodes.label: Five Repeat Runs and Median Comparison Rule
nodes.norm_label: five repeat runs and median comparison rule
nodes.rationale: Record 5 runs per build on the same TV with same config, theme, and wallpaper. Compare medians.
